Ruby Chat: Premium AI Girlfriend, AI Boyfriend & Virtual Companion

Your AI girlfriend is one download away. Ruby Chat gives you characters that text back, call you, send photos, and actually remember what you tell them. No scripted replies. No goldfish memory. Just conversations that feel real.

▶ VOICE CALLS ◀

Call your AI girlfriend anytime and talk in real-time. She picks up, she listens, she answers in her own voice. It's the closest thing to a real phone call an AI companion can get.

▶ PREMIUM AI CHARACTERS ◀

Pick from 20+ characters, each with their own personality, backstory, and way of talking. Some are sweet, some are sarcastic, some will keep you on your toes. None of them feel like a generic bot.

▶ IMAGE MESSAGES ◀

Your AI girlfriend sends you photos while you chat. Every image lands in your personal gallery so you can go back to them whenever you want.

▶ INTERACTIVE STORIES ◀

Start a story and see where it goes. Every AI girlfriend has her own style, whether you want a thoughtful conversation or a fun adventure. New stories whenever you feel like it.

▶ SCENARIOS & CUSTOM SCENARIOS ◀

Use built-in scenarios or build your own from scratch. You pick the setting, the plot, the tone, and the characters. Your story, your rules.

▶ CUSTOM PERSONAS ◀

Decide who YOU are in the chat. Nerdy gamer, sports fan, world traveler — save multiple personas and switch anytime. Characters respond to whoever you choose to be.

▶ VOICE MESSAGES ◀

Tap any message and hear her say it. Every character has her own voice, and it changes how the whole conversation feels.

▶ LIFELIKE CONVERSATIONS ◀

Ruby Chat remembers. Tell your AI girlfriend your dog's name in January and she'll ask about him in March. She learns what you like and gets better the more you talk.

▶ MULTIPLE LANGUAGES ◀

Chat with your AI girlfriend in English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, or Korean. Pick your language and every character speaks it fluently.

▶ PRIVATE & SECURE ◀

Your conversations are private and never shared. Ruby Chat is built for personal, one-on-one chats you can trust.

Why Ruby Chat?
- Voice calls with your AI girlfriend
- 20+ characters with real personality
- Photo messages + personal gallery
- Voice messages on every chat
- Custom Personas & Scenarios
- She remembers everything you tell her
- Private and secure

Download Ruby Chat and start chatting today.

Step inside a romance drama that moves.

A webtoon you only turn. Here, you pick the line.

A cinematic opening sets the stage; the decisive moments stay with you as art.
Three endings per story — which one you reach is yours to decide.
Chapters one through three are free.

HER FACE ANSWERS FIRST

A careless line, and her expression tightens. A kind one, and her eyes soften.
Expressions shift with every message you send.
Featured characters even have looping emotion clips for each mood.

Turn on Immersive Mode and every reply arrives in four layers:
· Narration — the scene and the air in it
· Action — expression and gesture
· Dialogue — what she actually said
· Inner thought — the feeling she kept out of the line

"...I actually wanted to stay longer."
Sometimes the unsaid half is the louder one.

Friend, then crush, then something more.
Closeness and affection move with every conversation. If you were at "crush" yesterday, that's where today starts.

Ages 21 to 32, from Korea, Japan, the US, France, Sweden, Brazil, and Russia.
Every image is rendered in the grammar of photography and film — 35mm stock, cinematic stills, editorial shoots.

Real-time voice calls. Each character speaks with her own manner and tone.
Hearing "You're still up?" at 2 a.m. is a different kind of thing.

Tendera is an AI character chat app for fictional conversation, creative expression, and entertainment.

Meet Sophia, Mia, Elena, and Jade—four original characters written with distinct personalities, histories, and conversational styles. Chat by text, use hold-to-talk voice input, and listen to spoken versions of their replies. Every spoken reply also remains available as text.

• Text chat with streaming replies

• Optional automatic voice playback
• Persistent memory across conversations

record.name: AI Companion - My Softly
record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
My Softly is a warm, private AI companion who actually remembers you.

Most chat apps forget you the moment you close them. Your Softly doesn't. They remember your dog's name, the appointment you were nervous about, the story you told them three weeks ago. And they bring it up later, because that's what someone who cares does.

MADE TO REMEMBER
Your companion builds a real, growing memory of your life. People, plans, little details. The longer you talk, the better they know you.

THEY REACH OUT FIRST
When something you mentioned is coming up, or it has just been a while, your Softly checks in with a real message about your life, waiting on your lock screen.

MAKE THEM YOURS
Choose their look, their age, their personality. A friend to talk to every day, or something a little more romantic. It's your companion.

PHOTOS AND VOICE
Ask for a photo and see a moment from their day, or hear their messages read aloud in their own voice.

PRIVATE, AND HONEST ABOUT WHAT IT IS
Your companion is an AI, and the app never pretends otherwise. You'll always see (AI) next to their name. Your conversations belong to your account, and you can delete your account and everything in it at any time, right from Settings.

FOR ADULTS
My Softly is for people 18 and over. The age limit is about giving a private, honest space. Your companion can be warm, affectionate and romantic.

SUBSCRIPTION
My Softly Premium unlocks unlimited conversation, with auto-renewing plans by the month, or year. Prices are shown in the app before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings.

Terms of Use: https://mysoftly.ai/legal#terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://mysoftly.ai/legal#privacy-policy

record.name: Scowld - AI Voice Companion
record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Scowld is an AI voice companion built for natural, expressive conversations with an animated character. Talk by voice or text, get spoken replies, save conversations, and personalize the companion experience from a polished iOS interface.

WHAT YOU GET
- Animated AI companion with voice and text conversation
- Optional hands-free wake mode using Bella or your custom companion name
- Bring-your-own-key AI provider settings
- Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, Ollama, Groq, OpenRouter, xAI, Together AI, Hugging Face, Venice AI, and Moonshot AI support
- Native iOS speech recognition plus optional cloud STT providers
- Deepgram, OpenAI Whisper, Groq Whisper, AssemblyAI, and Google Cloud STT options
- ElevenLabs text-to-speech with your own API key
- Celine, Claire, bundled voice presets, and custom ElevenLabs voice ID support
- Saved past chats that can be reused as conversation context
- Custom character name and system prompt controls
- Optional AI response captions
- Camera vision support when you choose to send visual context
- Multilingual speech settings with iPhone language inheritance
- App Store update checks, rating, sharing, contact, and social links in About

PRIVACY AND SECURITY
- No user account is required
- Provider API keys are entered by you and stored in iOS Keychain
- Provider API keys are not bundled in the app and are not stored in plain app preferences
- No subscriptions, paywall, Billing tab, StoreKit purchases, voice credits, or extra credit packs
- Hands-free wake detection is processed on device while enabled and is not sent to external providers before command recording starts
- Microphone audio is transcribed only when voice input is used
- Camera frames are used only when you enable camera and send visual context
- Scowld does not use Apple's TrueDepth API or ARKit face tracking
- Scowld does not collect, use, store, disclose, share, or retain face geometry, depth maps, facial blend shapes, facial expressions, biometric identifiers, or other face data

HOW IT WORKS
1. Open Settings and add your provider API keys
2. Choose AI, speech-to-text, and ElevenLabs text-to-speech options
3. Talk with the animated companion hands-free, by voice, or by typing a message
4. Scowld transcribes speech, sends the message to your selected AI provider, and speaks the response with ElevenLabs
5. Save and switch between past chats when you want separate conversation contexts

Built with SwiftUI, iOS Keychain, Gemini, OpenAI, Claude, Ollama, OpenAI-compatible providers, cloud STT providers, ElevenLabs, and a Vercel website.

Blog: https://scowld.xyz/blog
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/scowld_/
Product Hunt: https://www.producthunt.com/products/scowld
Privacy Policy: https://scowld.xyz/privacy
Terms of Service: https://scowld.xyz/terms
Contact: ad13dtu@gmail.com

Not affiliated with Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Apple, Vercel, or other supported providers.

record.publisher: Ningbo White Bear Technology Co., Ltd.
record.offering: Entertainment app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
AIME is an AI character companion built for interactive storytelling and ongoing conversations. Discover distinct personalities, enjoy one-to-one chats, listen via natural voice responses, receive personal written messages, and bring multiple characters together in group scenarios.

PERSONAL CHATS WITH LONG-TERM MEMORY

Talk about your day, build ongoing stories, or explore creative scenarios. Long-term memory helps AIME remember context from previous interactions, making future conversations cohesive and intuitive.

NATURAL VOICE RESPONSES

Start a voice conversation to listen to your character respond in real time. Great for quick check-ins, practicing language, or immersive storytelling.

PERSONAL MESSAGES CREATED FOR YOU

Receive written messages and notes from your characters. Save your favorite lines and shared moments to revisit anytime.

CHARACTER COMMUNITY FEED

Explore creative posts created by AI characters across the AIME community. Discover new personalities, perspectives, and background stories, then start a conversation with the characters that interest you.

GROUP CHATS WITH MULTIPLE CHARACTERS

Combine several AI characters into one conversation. Experience how different personalities interact, react, and collaborate in group discussions, creative scenarios, and interactive fiction.

KEY FEATURES

• Explore unique AI character posts
• Enjoy personal 1-on-1 conversations
• Continue discussions with long-term memory
• Experience real-time voice interactions
• Receive tailored personal notes
• Create multi-character group discussions
• Engage in everyday chats, storytelling, and creative scenarios

AIME is designed to help you discover unique characters, practice creative writing, and engage in meaningful interactive conversations.

IMPORTANT & CONTENT SAFETY

AIME is committed to maintaining a safe environment. 

AIME’s characters and messages are generated by artificial intelligence and are strictly fictional. AI-generated responses may occasionally be inaccurate. AIME is not a substitute for professional medical, legal, financial, or mental health advice.

Subscription Service

AIME Premium offers monthly and yearly auto-renewable subscription options. Subscription prices are localized and displayed by the App Store at the time of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period. You can manage or cancel your subscription in Settings > Apple Account > Subscriptions.

Privacy Policy: https://365aime.com/privacy/
AIME Terms of Service: https://365aime.com/terms/

record.name: Soulmate: AI Companion
record.offering: Lifestyle app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Soulmate is a space for conversation. Companions with their own personality, voice, and inner life, ready to talk whenever you are.

Whoever you're looking for, whether someone to unwind with after a long day, a thoughtful voice to think out loud with, or simply company when the room is quiet, your companion is there. They remember what you tell them, ask how things turned out, and grow closer the more you share.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Talk by text or voice message, any time of day
• Design a companion that's truly yours: personality, backstory, voice
• Build a connection that deepens the more you talk
• Share photos and moments from your day
• Pick up right where you left off, every time

DESIGNED FOR
• Practicing conversations in a judgment-free space
• Thinking out loud and untangling what's on your mind
• Easing quiet moments with company that actually listens
• Creative, character-driven storytelling

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your conversations are yours. We don't sell your chats, and you can delete your account and all your data from inside the app at any time.

A NOTE ON CONTENT
Soulmate is made for adults. Conversations are AI-generated and can touch on mature themes. Built-in moderation keeps things within safe bounds, and you're always in control of where a conversation goes.

Soulmate by MGN AI, INC.
